scope: Exploratory GPU compositor experiment on a shared desktop; not the release performance gate
order: CPU GPU GPU CPU across adjacent paired samples
correctness: Every timed result must be byte-identical to the untimed CPU reference
render_time: CPU engine execution versus CPU GPU-program preparation plus completed upload, GPU execution and RGBA readback
frame_time: Render time including worker/WASI output transport in both paths
excluded_once: first GPU buffer allocation and packet validation
interactive_demo: Nine samples after two warmups; illustrative only
